english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.english: Today it is raining.
Sam does not go out of the house.
He is in the room.
He looks out of the window.
There are no people in the street.
Sam does not buy bread today.
He eats bread and cheese.
Sam can read.

sentences.text: Ai pi kafe dhe lexon një libër.
sentences.english: He drinks coffee and reads a book.
The book is in Albanian.
Then he drinks tea.

sentences.text: Ai është i lumtur në shtëpi.
sentences.english: He is happy at home.

sentences.text: Ardi nuk shkon në fshat sot.
sentences.english: Ardi does not go to the village today.

sentences.text: Ardi do të luajë në rrugë.
sentences.english: Ardi wants to play in the street.

sentences.text: Në verë ai luan në rrugë çdo ditë, por sot bie shi.
sentences.english: In summer he plays in the street every day, but today it is raining.

sentences.text: — Gjyshe, a mund të dal? — pyet Ardi.
sentences.english: "Grandmother, may I go out?" asks Ardi.
"No, Ardi. Not today."
Ardi looks out of the window.

sentences.text: Ai është në dhomë me macen.
sentences.english: He is in the room with the cat.
Ardi reads with the cat.

sentences.text: Gjyshja i jep çaj dhe bukë.
sentences.english: Grandmother gives him tea and bread.

sentences.text: Ardi pi çaj dhe ha bukë.
sentences.english: Ardi drinks tea and eats bread.
The cat drinks milk.
Now it is not raining.
Ardi thinks: I can go out!

sentences.text: Ai e gjen çantën dhe e merr.
sentences.english: He finds his bag and takes it.
Elira is in the street.

sentences.text: Ardi është në rrugë me Elirën.
sentences.english: Ardi is in the street with Elira.
"Elira, shall we play?" asks Ardi.
"Yes, Ardi!"

sentences.text: Ardi dhe Elira fillojnë të luajnë.
sentences.english: Ardi and Elira begin to play.
Then Ardi goes into the house.

sentences.text: Gjyshja i jep një mollë të kuqe.
sentences.english: Grandmother gives him a red apple.
Ardi eats the apple.
Sam thinks about Albania.

sentences.text: Ai jeton këtu dhe mëson shqip.
sentences.english: He lives here and is learning Albanian.
He begins to understand a lot.

sentences.text: Ai pi kafe me Luanin dhe Anën.
sentences.english: He drinks coffee with Luan and Ana.
Sam is happy here.

sentences.text: Sot Sam nuk del nga shtëpia.
sentences.english: Today Sam does not go out of the house.

sentences.text: Në shtëpi ka bukë, kafe dhe çaj.
sentences.english: At home there is bread, coffee and tea.

sentences.text: Sam ha bukë dhe pi kafe.
sentences.english: Sam eats bread and drinks coffee.

sentences.text: Ardi ha bukë dhe pi çaj.
sentences.english: Ardi eats bread and drinks tea.

sentences.text: Sam lexon një libër, dhe Ardi lexon një libër.
sentences.english: Sam reads a book, and Ardi reads a book.

sentences.text: Sot nuk ka njerëz në rrugë, por Sam është i lumtur në shtëpi.
sentences.english: Today there are no people in the street, but Sam is happy at home.
